description: This Java class implements a service for handling RPC (Remote Procedure Call) requests and responses between devices and rule engine components within the Thingsboard platform. It manages RPC request processing, response handling, timeouts, and communication with other services or actors.

classes.name: DefaultTbCoreDeviceRpcService
classes.description: Service class managing RPC requests and responses between devices and rule engine components, including timeouts and actor communication.

methods.name: processRestApiRpcRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming RPC requests from REST API, stores response consumer, sends request to rule engine, and schedules timeout.

methods.name: processRpcResponseFromRuleEngine
methods.description: Processes responses from rule engine, delivering them to the stored consumer or logging unknown responses.

methods.name: forwardRpcRequestToDeviceActor
methods.description: Forwards RPC request to device actor, stores request, and schedules timeout.

methods.name: processRpcResponseFromDeviceActor
methods.description: Handles responses from device actor, forwards to rule engine if recognized.

methods.name: processRemoveRpc
methods.description: Processes request to remove RPC actor.

methods.name: sendRpcResponseToTbRuleEngine
methods.description: Sends RPC response to rule engine, either locally or via cluster notification.

methods.name: sendRpcRequestToRuleEngine
methods.description: Constructs and sends an RPC request message to the rule engine, including device info and metadata.

methods.name: scheduleToRuleEngineTimeout
methods.description: Schedules a timeout task for RPC request to rule engine, triggers timeout response if no reply.

methods.name: scheduleToDeviceTimeout
methods.description: Schedules a timeout for device RPC request, removes request if timeout occurs.

methods.name: initExecutor
methods.description: Initializes scheduled executor and service ID after construction.

methods.name: shutdownExecutor
methods.description: Shuts down the scheduler on service destruction.
